method: Checked candidate URLs, DOIs and normalized titles against the published archive and prior scope hold, then screened source pages and passages. Included records have relevant source text and dated source metadata; non-English translations await native-language review. Unreviewed or inaccessible items remain pending. Exact comparison does not rule out incident duplicates. Follow-up reviewed source pages and available document texts, checked incident overlap and distinguished national guidance, datasets and conference abstracts. Published source claims remain attributed; non-English translations need native-language review. Follow-up checked accessible originals, OCR of Thai scans, dates, relevant geographic evidence and possible duplicate events. Sources without adequate accessible evidence remain on hold; linked national policy and dated orders are described with their limits.
